question: For the customer who made a transaction of exactly 634.8 on 2012-08-25, calculate the percentage change in their annual consumption from 2012 to 2013. Only include customers who had non-zero consumption in 2012. Return the result as a single percentage value.

    CAST(
        (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) - 
         SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END)) AS REAL
    ) * 100 / 
    SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage_change
FROM yearmonth y
WHERE y.XCL_019 = (
    SELECT t.XCL_013 
    FROM transactions_1k t 
    WHERE t.XCL_011 = '2012-08-25' 
      AND t.XCL_018 = 634.8
)
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTRING(y.XCL_020, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN y.XCL_021 ELSE 0 END) != 0
